# APIAny.AI Docs

APIAny.AI is an AI API aggregation platform for image, video, chat, and multimodal model access.

Important pages:

- Introduction: /introduction
- Quickstart: /quickstart
- Authentication: /authentication
- Chinese introduction: /zh/introduction
- Chinese quickstart: /zh/quickstart
- Chinese authentication: /zh/authentication
- Chat completions: /reference/chat-completions
- Anthropic messages: /reference/messages
- Gemini generateContent: /reference/gemini-generate-content
- Image generation: /reference/image-generation
- Image models, including GPT Image 2.6 PNG and GIF requests: /models/image-models
- Chinese image models: /zh/models/image-models
- Video generation: /reference/video-generation
- Tasks: /reference/tasks
- Batch image APIs: /reference/batch-image-apis
- OpenAPI specification: /openapi.json
- Chinese OpenAPI specification: /zh/openapi.json

Public API base URL:

```txt
https://apiany.ai
```

Authentication:

```txt
Authorization: Bearer $APIANY_API_KEY
```
